title: Rainy or Sunny?
instructions: Look at the weather and tap what we need.

questions.q: It is raining. What do we need?
questions.good: Yes! An umbrella keeps us dry!

questions.q: It is very sunny. What do we wear?
questions.good: A cap keeps the sun away!

questions.q: It is snowy and cold. What do we wear?
It is night. What do we see in the sky?
It is windy. What can fly high?

title: Find the Different One
desc: One picture is not like the others!
instructions: Look carefully and tap the one that is different.

questions.q: Which one is not a fruit?
questions.good: Yes! A car is not a fruit!

questions.q: Which one cannot fly?
questions.good: Right! Elephants walk on the ground!

questions.q: Which one is not a vehicle?
questions.good: Yummy cake is not a vehicle!

questions.q: Which one does not live in water?
questions.good: Cock-a-doodle-doo! The rooster lives on land!

questions.q: Which one is not a toy?
questions.good: Crunch! A carrot is a yummy vegetable!

title: My Body
instructions: Listen and tap the right picture.

questions.q: What do we see with?
questions.good: Yes! We see with our eyes!

questions.q: What do we hear with?
What do we smell flowers with?
What do we clap with?
What do we kick a ball with?
